title: Murakkab grammatik tuzilmalar ustasi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida inkor inversiyasi, shart inversiyasi, cleft gaplar va “Strange as it may seem” turidagi to‘siqsiz qurilmalarni xatosiz tuzasiz, mandativ subjunktiv va noreal o‘tgan zamonni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, joy inversiyasi va end-weight bilan so‘z tartibini boshqarasiz hamda bir fikrni uch xil uslubda ifodalay olasiz.

scenes.title: Grammatikaning oliy pog‘onasi
board: Inversion · Clefts · Subjunctive · Word order
(Grammatika — uslub quroli)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ritorik vositalar va nutq san’atini o‘rgandik: uchlik, antiteza, takror. Bugun o‘sha ta’sirchanlikni grammatika orqali yaratamiz. Dars oxirida inversiya va ajratilgan gaplarni tuzasiz, subjunktiv maylni ishlatasiz, so‘z tartibini ongli boshqarasiz va qaysi tuzilma qaysi uslubga mos ekanini bilasiz.
scenes.say: Never before have you had so many grammatical tools at your disposal. What matters now is knowing when to use them.
scenes.say_uz: Hech qachon sizning ixtiyoringizda bunchalik ko‘p grammatik vosita bo‘lmagan. Endi muhimi — ularni qachon ishlatishni bilish.

scenes.title: Odatiy va belgilangan tartib
board: Unmarked: Subject + Verb + Object
Marked: Never have I seen such chaos.
Why? emphasis · contrast · cohesion · style

examples.t: I have never seen such chaos.
examples.uz: Men hech qachon bunday tartibsizlik ko‘rmaganman. (oddiy)

examples.t: Never have I seen such chaos.
examples.uz: Hech qachon bunday tartibsizlik ko‘rmaganman! (ta’kidli, rasmiy)

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida so‘z tartibi qat’iy: ega, kesim, to‘ldiruvchi. O‘zbek tilida tartib erkinroq, chunki qo‘shimchalar vazifani ko‘rsatadi. Aynan qat’iy tartib bo‘lgani uchun ingliz tilida undan chetga chiqish kuchli signal beradi: bu ta’kid, qarama-qarshilik yoki yuksak uslub. Bugungi barcha tuzilmalar shu tamoyilga tayanadi: odatiy tartibni ataylab buzish.
scenes.say: Because English word order is so rigid, every departure from it is noticed. That is precisely what gives these structures their power.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida so‘z tartibi juda qat’iy bo‘lgani uchun undan har bir chetlanish seziladi. Bu tuzilmalarga kuch beradigan narsa aynan shu.

scenes.title: Inkor inversiyasi
board: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + verb
Never / Rarely / Seldom / Not once / At no time
Rarely does she complain. (do-support)

examples.t: Rarely does she complain.
examples.uz: U kamdan-kam shikoyat qiladi.

examples.t: Not once did he apologise.
examples.uz: U bir marta ham uzr so‘ramadi.

examples.t: At no time were the staff informed.
examples.uz: Xodimlarga hech qachon xabar berilmagan.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu — kam uchraydigan murakkab tuzilmalar, avvalo inkor inversiyasi. Inkor yoki cheklovchi ravish gap boshiga chiqsa, ega va yordamchi fe’l savol gapdagidek o‘rin almashadi. Yordamchi fe’l bo‘lmasa, “do”, “does”, “did” qo‘shiladi: “Rarely does she complain.” Ravishlar: never, rarely, seldom, not once, at no time. Bu uslub rasmiy, yozma yoki ta’sirchan nutqqa xos.
scenes.say: Rarely does a politician admit a mistake. Seldom have I heard such nonsense. At no time was the public told the truth.
scenes.say_uz: Siyosatchi kamdan-kam xatosini tan oladi. Bunday bema’ni gapni kam eshitganman. Jamoatchilikka hech qachon haqiqat aytilmagan.

scenes.title: Vaqt inversiyalari
board: Hardly / Scarcely had I … when …
No sooner had I … than …
Not until … did … · Only when / after … did …

examples.t: No sooner had we sat down than the phone rang.
examples.uz: O‘tirishimiz bilan telefon jiringladi.

examples.t: Hardly had she left when it started to rain.
examples.uz: U chiqib ketishi bilan yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

examples.t: Only when I got home did I realise my mistake.
examples.uz: Faqat uyga kelgandagina xatoimni angladim.

scenes.say_native: Vaqtga oid inversiyalar ikki voqeaning ketma-ketligini ta’kidlaydi. “No sooner had … than” va “Hardly had … when” — “…ishi bilan” ma’nosida, odatda past perfect bilan. Juftliklarni adashtirmang: no sooner bilan “than”, hardly va scarcely bilan “when”. “Not until” va “only when” bilan esa inversiya ikkinchi, asosiy gapda bo‘ladi: “Only when I got home did I realise.”
scenes.say: No sooner had the minister finished speaking than the protests began. Only then did the government realise how deep the anger ran.
scenes.say_uz: Vazir gapini tugatishi bilan noroziliklar boshlandi. Faqat shundagina hukumat g‘azab qanchalik chuqur ekanini angladi.

scenes.title: Not only, Little, On no account
board: Not only did she win, but she also broke the record.
Little did they know that …
Under no circumstances / On no account should you …

examples.t: Little did they know that the war would last six years.
examples.uz: Ular urush olti yil davom etishini sira bilmasdi.

examples.t: On no account should you open this door.
examples.uz: Hech qanday holatda bu eshikni ochmang.

scenes.say_native: Yana uchta muhim qolip. “Not only did she win, but she also…” — inversiya faqat birinchi qismda, “but also” qismida odatiy tartib. “Little did they know” — “sira bilishmasdi”, hikoya va publitsistikada sevimli dramatik ibora. “Under no circumstances” va “On no account” — qat’iy taqiq, ko‘pincha rasmiy qoidalarda. O‘zbekchada bunday ta’kidni “sira”, “aslo”, “hech qachon” so‘zlari bilan beramiz, inglizlar esa tartib bilan.
scenes.say: Little did the passengers know that the captain had never flown this route before.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘lovchilar kapitan bu yo‘nalishda ilgari hech qachon uchmaganini sira bilishmasdi.

scenes.title: Inversiyadagi xatolar
board: ✗ Never I have seen … → ✓ Never have I seen …
✗ Rarely she goes out. → ✓ Rarely does she go out.
✗ No sooner had I arrived when … → ✓ … than …
✗ Only when I left I realised. → ✓ … did I realise.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilarning eng ko‘p xatosi — ravishni boshga chiqarib, tartibni o‘zgartirmaslik: “Never I have seen”. O‘zbekchada so‘z tartibini erkin o‘zgartirish mumkin, inglizchada esa boshga chiqargan zahoti inversiya majburiy. Ikkinchi xato — “do”ni unutish. Uchinchisi — “no sooner” bilan “when” ishlatish. To‘rtinchisi — “only when” qismidan keyin asosiy gapda inversiyani qo‘llamaslik.
scenes.say: Think of it as a question without a question mark. If you can turn it into a question, you can invert it.
scenes.say_uz: Buni so‘roq belgisiz savol deb tasavvur qiling. Agar uni savolga aylantira olsangiz, inversiya ham qila olasiz.

scenes.title: Inversiya bilan qayta yozing
board: 1 I have never tasted such good bread. (Never…)
2 He didn't say a word all evening. (Not once…)
3 As soon as I closed my eyes, the alarm went off. (No sooner…)
4 You must not tell anyone. (Under no circumstances…)
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz qayta tuzing. Har bir gapni qavs ichidagi so‘z bilan boshlang va inversiya qiling. Yordamchi fe’lni tanlashga e’tibor bering: zamon saqlanadi, “do” kerak bo‘lsa, unutmang. Uchinchisida zamon o‘zgaradi: past perfect kerak bo‘ladi. Pauza qilib, javoblarni ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite each sentence, starting with the words in brackets.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qavs ichidagi so‘zlar bilan boshlab, qayta yozing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Never have I tasted such good bread.
2 Not once did he say a word all evening.
3 No sooner had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
4 Under no circumstances must you tell anyone.
scenes.say_native: Birinchisida present perfect saqlanadi: “Never have I tasted”. Ikkinchisida past simple, shuning uchun “did” kerak: “Not once did he say”. Uchinchisida “as soon as” “no sooner … than”ga aylanadi va zamon past perfect bo‘ladi. To‘rtinchisida modal fe’l o‘zi yordamchi: “must you”. “Should you” varianti ham to‘g‘ri, u biroz yumshoqroq.
scenes.say: Under no circumstances must you tell anyone. Notice that modal verbs invert directly, just as they do in questions.
scenes.say_uz: Hech qanday holatda hech kimga aytmasligingiz kerak. E’tibor bering, modal fe’llar savoldagidek to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri o‘rin almashadi.

scenes.title: Shart inversiyasi
board: Had I known … = If I had known …
Should you need … = If you (happen to) need …
Were it not for … / Had it not been for …

examples.t: Had I known, I would have called.
examples.uz: Bilganimda, qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: Should you require assistance, please contact reception.
examples.uz: Yordam kerak bo‘lsa, qabulxonaga murojaat qiling.

examples.t: Were it not for her help, we would have failed.
examples.uz: Uning yordami bo‘lmaganida, muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan bo‘lardik.

scenes.say_native: Shart gaplarda “if”ni tushirib, inversiya qilish mumkin, lekin faqat uchta fe’l bilan: had, should va were. “Had I known” — uchinchi tur shart. “Should you need” — rasmiy, ehtimoli past holat, mehmonxona va biznes xatlarida juda ko‘p. “Were it not for” — “…bo‘lmaganida”. Inkor shakliga e’tibor bering: “Had I not known”, hech qachon “Hadn't I known” emas.
scenes.say: Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. You'll find that sentence at the end of countless formal emails.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘shimcha savollaringiz bo‘lsa, biz bilan bog‘lanishdan tortinmang. Bu gapni son-sanoqsiz rasmiy xatlar oxirida uchratasiz.

scenes.title: Ajratilgan gaplar: cleft
board: It-cleft: It was Aziz who/that found the error.
Wh-cleft: What we need is more time.
All-cleft: All I want is some peace.

examples.t: It was in 1991 that Uzbekistan became independent.
examples.uz: O‘zbekiston aynan 1991-yilda mustaqil bo‘ldi.

examples.t: What surprised me was his honesty.
examples.uz: Meni hayron qoldirgan narsa uning halolligi bo‘ldi.

examples.t: All she did was ask a question.
examples.uz: U faqat savol berdi, xolos.

scenes.say_native: Cleft, ya’ni ajratilgan gap bitta bo‘lakni ta’kidlash uchun gapni ikkiga bo‘ladi. It-cleft: “It was Aziz who found the error” — xatoni aynan Aziz topdi, boshqasi emas. Wh-cleft: “What we need is time” — e’tibor oxirgi so‘zga tortiladi. All-cleft: “All I want is…” — “faqat”, “xolos”. O‘zbekchada bunday ta’kidni “aynan” so‘zi va fe’l oldidagi o‘rin bilan beramiz: “Xatoni Aziz topdi.” Inglizcha esa grammatik qolip kerak.
scenes.say: It wasn't the price that worried me. What worried me was the silence afterwards.
scenes.say_uz: Meni narx emas, keyingi sukunat xavotirga soldi.

scenes.title: To‘siqsiz fronting
board: Strange as it may seem, … = Although it may seem strange, …
Try as I might, … · Much as I admire him, …
Adjective / Adverb / Verb + as + subject + verb

examples.t: Strange as it may seem, I enjoy exams.
examples.uz: G‘alati tuyulsa ham, imtihonlarni yoqtiraman.

examples.t: Try as I might, I couldn't open the jar.
examples.uz: Qancha urinmay, bankani ocholmadim.

examples.t: Much as I admire him, I can't support this plan.
examples.uz: Uni qanchalik hurmat qilsam ham, bu rejani qo‘llay olmayman.

scenes.say_native: Bu qurilma “although” ma’nosini beradi, lekin ancha nafis eshitiladi. Sifat, ravish yoki fe’l boshga chiqadi, keyin “as”, ega va kesim keladi: “Strange as it may seem”, “Tired as she was”, “Try as I might”, “Much as I admire him”. O‘zbekchadagi “-sa ham”, “qancha …-may” qo‘shimchalari aynan shu vazifani bajaradi. Bu tuzilma esse, nutq va adabiy matnda juda qadrlanadi.
scenes.say: Tired as she was, she finished the report. Much as I'd love to stay, I have a train to catch.
scenes.say_uz: Charchagan bo‘lsa ham, u hisobotni tugatdi. Qolishni qanchalik xohlasam ham, poyezdga ulgurishim kerak.

scenes.title: “…sa ham, lekin” tuzog‘i
board: ✗ Much as I like him, but I disagree.
✓ Much as I like him, I disagree.
✗ What we need it is more time.
✓ What we need is more time.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek va rus tilida so‘zlashuvchilarga xos xato — to‘siqsiz qismdan keyin yana “but” qo‘shish. O‘zbekchada “yoqtirsam ham, lekin…” deyish mumkin, ruschada ham “хотя…, но…” odatiy. Inglizchada esa “although” yoki “much as” bor joyda “but” ortiqcha. Ikkinchi xato — wh-cleft ichiga ortiqcha “it” qo‘yish: “What we need it is”. Wh-qism o‘zi ega, unga takroriy olmosh kerak emas.
scenes.say: One concession, one connector. 'Although' and 'but' never share the same sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta to‘siqsizlik, bitta bog‘lovchi. “Although” va “but” hech qachon bir gapda birga kelmaydi.

scenes.title: Tuzilmani o‘zgartiring
board: 1 If I had seen the email, I would have replied. (Had…)
2 Maria broke the window, not Tom. (It was…)
3 Although the task was difficult, we finished it. (Difficult as…)
4 We need a clear plan. (What…)
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtta gapni qavsdagi so‘zdan boshlab qayta tuzing. Birinchisi shart inversiyasi, ikkinchisi it-cleft, uchinchisi to‘siqsiz fronting, to‘rtinchisi wh-cleft. Ma’no o‘zgarmasligi kerak, faqat urg‘u va uslub o‘zgaradi. Uchinchisida “but” qo‘shmaslikni unutmang.
scenes.say: Transform each sentence, keeping the meaning but changing the emphasis.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni ma’nosini saqlab, urg‘usini o‘zgartirib qayta tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Had I seen the email, I would have replied.
2 It was Maria who/that broke the window.
3 Difficult as the task was, we finished it.
4 What we need is a clear plan.
scenes.say_native: Birinchisida “if” tushib, “had” boshga chiqadi. Ikkinchisida inson haqida gap bo‘lgani uchun “who” ham, “that” ham to‘g‘ri. Uchinchisida sifat boshga chiqadi, “as” keladi, keyin odatiy tartib: “the task was”. To‘rtinchisida “what” qismi ega bo‘lib, “is” orqali ta’kidlanadigan qism bilan bog‘lanadi. Bunday javoblar C2 imtihonlarining “key word transformation” topshiriqlarida tez-tez uchraydi.
scenes.say: Difficult as the task was, we finished it. Notice: the adjective jumps to the front, and the rest stays in normal order.
scenes.say_uz: Vazifa qiyin bo‘lsa ham, uni tugatdik. E’tibor bering: sifat oldinga sakraydi, qolgani odatiy tartibda qoladi.

scenes.title: Sifatdosh va mustaqil oborotlar
board: Having finished the report, she went home.
Weather permitting, we'll eat outside.
The meeting over, we left. (absolute clause)

examples.t: Having been warned twice, he had no excuse.
examples.uz: Ikki marta ogohlantirilgan bo‘lgani uchun uning bahonasi yo‘q edi.

examples.t: All things considered, it was a success.
examples.uz: Hammasini hisobga olganda, bu muvaffaqiyat edi.

scenes.say_native: Sifatdosh oborotlar gapni ixchamlaydi: “Having finished the report” — “hisobotni tugatib”. O‘zbek tilidagi “-ib”, “-gach” ravishdoshlari bunga juda o‘xshaydi. Mustaqil, ya’ni absolute oborotlarning o‘z egasi bor: “The meeting over, we left” — “majlis tugagach, ketdik”. “Weather permitting” — “ob-havo imkon bersa”, “all things considered” — “hammasini hisobga olganda”. Bular rasmiy va adabiy uslubga xos.
scenes.say: The speeches over and the guests gone, the old man sat alone in the garden.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqlar tugab, mehmonlar ketgach, chol bog‘da yolg‘iz o‘tirdi.

scenes.title: Egasiz qolgan oborot
board: ✗ Walking into the room, the lights went off.
✓ As I walked into the room, the lights went off.
✗ Having eaten lunch, the bus arrived.
✓ Having eaten lunch, we caught the bus.
scenes.say_native: Dangling participle — eng mashhur uslubiy xato. Sifatdosh oborotning egasi asosiy gapning egasi bilan bir xil bo‘lishi shart. “Walking into the room, the lights went off” grammatik jihatdan chiroqlar xonaga kirib kelganini anglatadi. O‘zbek tilida ham shunday qoida bor: “Xonaga kirib, chiroq o‘chdi” g‘alati eshitiladi. Tuzatish uchun yoki egani almashtiring, yoki to‘liq ergash gap ishlating.
scenes.say: Having eaten lunch, the bus arrived. Really? I've never seen a bus eat anything.
scenes.say_uz: Tushlik qilib bo‘lib, avtobus keldi. Rostdanmi? Avtobusning biror narsa yeganini hech ko‘rmaganman.

scenes.title: Tinglash: rahbar bilan intervyu
board: A journalist interviews a CEO after a failed merger
Listen for: inversion · cleft · concession · subjunctive
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Jurnalist muvaffaqiyatsiz birlashuvdan keyin kompaniya rahbari bilan suhbatlashyapti. Rahbar rasmiy, ehtiyotkor gapiradi va bugungi tuzilmalarning deyarli barchasidan foydalanadi. Ularni sanab boring: inversiya, ajratilgan gap, to‘siqsiz fronting va subjunktiv. Keyin mazmun bo‘yicha savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Journalist: Did you expect the merger to fail? CEO: Not for a moment did we imagine it would collapse so quickly. Had we known about the debts, we would never have signed. Journalist: Some say you ignored the warnings. CEO: What we misjudged was not the warnings but the timing. Strange as it may sound, the figures looked healthy. Journalist: And now? CEO: We have insisted that the board be replaced. Should investors wish to meet us, our door is open.
scenes.say_uz: Jurnalist: Birlashuv barbod bo‘lishini kutganmidingiz? Rahbar: U bunchalik tez qulashini bir lahza ham o‘ylamagandik. Qarzlar haqida bilganimizda, hech qachon imzolamagan bo‘lardik. Jurnalist: Ba’zilar ogohlantirishlarni e’tiborsiz qoldirgansiz, deydi. Rahbar: Biz xato baholaganimiz ogohlantirishlar emas, vaqt edi. G‘alati eshitilsa ham, raqamlar yaxshi ko‘rinardi. Jurnalist: Endi-chi? Rahbar: Kengash almashtirilishini talab qildik. Investorlar biz bilan uchrashmoqchi bo‘lsa, eshigimiz ochiq.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 Did the company know about the debts?
2 What, according to the CEO, did they misjudge?
3 What have they demanded?
4 Find one inversion, one cleft and one subjunctive.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Kompaniya qarzlar haqida bilganmi? Rahbarning aytishicha, ular aslida nimani noto‘g‘ri baholagan? Ular nimani talab qilgan? Va nihoyat, dialogdan bitta inversiya, bitta ajratilgan gap va bitta subjunktiv shaklni toping. Ehtiyot bo‘ling, inversiya bittadan ko‘p.
scenes.say: Answer the first three questions in plain English, then hunt for the structures.
scenes.say_uz: Dastlabki uchta savolga oddiy ingliz tilida javob bering, keyin tuzilmalarni qidiring.

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1 No: 'Had we known…' = they didn't know.
2 The timing, not the warnings
3 That the board be replaced
4 Not for a moment did we… · What we misjudged was… · be replaced
scenes.say_native: “Had we known about the debts” — demak, ular bilmagan: shart inversiyasi noreal o‘tmishni bildiradi. Rahbar ogohlantirishlarni emas, vaqtni xato baholaganini aytadi, bu wh-cleft bilan ta’kidlangan. Ular kengash almashtirilishini talab qilgan: “insisted that the board be replaced” — subjunktiv. Inversiyalar uchta: “Not for a moment did we”, “Had we known”, “Should investors wish”. To‘siqsiz fronting esa “Strange as it may sound”.
scenes.say: Every structure here does a job: inversion adds drama, the cleft shifts the blame, and the subjunctive sounds firm and official.
scenes.say_uz: Bu yerda har bir tuzilma vazifa bajaradi: inversiya drama qo‘shadi, cleft aybni boshqa tomonga suradi, subjunktiv esa qat’iy va rasmiy eshitiladi.

scenes.title: Mandativ subjunktiv
board: insist / demand / recommend / suggest / propose + that + base form
essential / vital / imperative + that + base form
that he be · that she attend · that they not leave

examples.t: The doctor recommended that he rest for a week.
examples.uz: Shifokor unga bir hafta dam olishni tavsiya qildi.

examples.t: It is essential that every student attend.
examples.uz: Har bir talabaning qatnashishi shart.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu — mayl nozikliklari. Mandativ subjunktiv talab, tavsiya yoki zaruratdan keyin keladi: insist, demand, recommend, suggest; essential, vital, imperative. “That” dan keyin fe’lning asos shakli turadi: uchinchi shaxsda ham “-s” yo‘q, zamon yo‘q: “that he rest”, “that she attend”, “be” esa hamma shaxsda “be”. Inkor: “that they not leave”, “do”siz.
scenes.say: The committee demanded that the report be published in full and that no names be removed.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘mita hisobot to‘liq e’lon qilinishini va hech bir ism o‘chirilmasligini talab qildi.

scenes.title: Britancha va amerikacha variant
board: US & formal UK: I suggest that he be told.
UK alternative: I suggest that he should be told.
Informal UK: I suggest that he's told.

examples.t: We propose that the meeting be postponed.
examples.uz: Majlisni keyinga qoldirishni taklif qilamiz. (rasmiy)

examples.t: We propose that the meeting should be postponed.
examples.uz: Majlisni keyinga qoldirishni taklif qilamiz. (britancha)

scenes.say_native: Bu yerda Britaniya va Amerika farqi bor. Amerika ingliz tilida subjunktiv odatiy, kundalik nutqda ham. Britaniyada u rasmiy matnda keng tarqalgan, lekin ko‘pincha “should” bilan almashtiriladi: “that he should be told”. Norasmiy britancha nutqda hatto oddiy indikativ ham eshitiladi: “that he's told”. Rasmiy yozuvda subjunktiv yoki “should” variantini tanlang, ikkalasi ham xavfsiz.
scenes.say: In a formal report, write 'we recommend that the policy be reviewed'. It works on both sides of the Atlantic.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy hisobotda “siyosat qayta ko‘rib chiqilishini tavsiya qilamiz” deb yozing. Bu Atlantikaning ikkala tomonida ham ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Were-subjunktiv va qolip iboralar
board: If I were you · I wish it were … · as it were
Be that as it may · Come what may · Suffice it to say
So be it · Heaven forbid · God save the King

examples.t: Be that as it may, we must decide today.
examples.uz: Nima bo‘lganda ham, bugun qaror qilishimiz kerak.

examples.t: Suffice it to say, he won't be invited again.
examples.uz: Shuni aytish kifoyaki, uni boshqa taklif qilishmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi shakl — “were”: noreal holatda barcha shaxslar bilan. “If I were you” va “as it were” qotgan iboralar, ularda faqat “were”. Boshqa joylarda norasmiy nutqda “was” ham eshitiladi, rasmiy uslubda esa “were”. Ingliz tilida eski subjunktiv qolip iboralarda ham saqlangan: “Be that as it may” — “nima bo‘lganda ham”, “Come what may” — “nima bo‘lsa bo‘lsin”, “Suffice it to say” — “shuni aytish kifoya”.
scenes.say: Come what may, we'll finish this project. Suffice it to say, it hasn't been easy.
scenes.say_uz: Nima bo‘lsa bo‘lsin, bu loyihani tugatamiz. Shuni aytish kifoyaki, oson bo‘lmadi.

scenes.title: Noreal o‘tgan zamon
board: It's (high) time we left.
I'd rather you didn't smoke here.
If only I had listened! · He acts as if he owned the place.

examples.t: It's high time you got a job.
examples.uz: Ishga kirishing vaqti allaqachon keldi.

examples.t: I'd rather you told me the truth.
examples.uz: Menga haqiqatni aytganingizni afzal ko‘rardim.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi iboralardan keyin o‘tgan zamon shakli o‘tmishni emas, noreal yoki istalgan hozirni bildiradi. “It's time we left” — “ketish vaqti keldi”, “high time” esa kechikkanlikni ta’kidlaydi. “I'd rather you didn't” — boshqa odamning harakatini xohlash. “If only” — afsus, “as if he owned the place” — “xuddi bu yerning egasidek”. O‘zbekchada bunday ma’noni “-sa edi”, “-gandek” bilan beramiz.
scenes.say: It's high time we stopped pretending, and I'd rather you heard it from me than from anyone else.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zimizni aldashni to‘xtatish vaqti allaqachon keldi va buni boshqalardan emas, mendan eshitganingizni afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Mayldagi xatolar
board: ✗ I suggest him to go. → ✓ I suggest (that) he go / he should go.
✗ It's high time we go. → ✓ … we went.
✗ I'd rather you don't. → ✓ I'd rather you didn't.
✗ that he doesn't attend → ✓ that he not attend
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. “Suggest” dan keyin “somebody to do” ishlatilmaydi: “I suggest him to go” xato, ruscha “предлагаю ему пойти” ta’sirida chiqadi. To‘g‘ri: “I suggest that he go” yoki “he should go”. “It's high time” va “I'd rather you” dan keyin o‘tgan zamon kerak. Subjunktivning inkorida “do” ishlatilmaydi: “that he not attend”. Bu shakllar C2 imtihonlarida ayniqsa ko‘p tekshiriladi.
scenes.say: 'Suggest' never takes an object plus an infinitive. Suggest that someone do something, or suggest doing it.
scenes.say_uz: “Suggest” hech qachon to‘ldiruvchi va infinitiv bilan kelmaydi. Kimdir nimadir qilishini taklif qiling yoki biror ishni qilishni taklif qiling.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang
board: 1 The board insisted that she ___ (be) present.
2 It's time the children ___ (go) to bed.
3 I'd rather you ___ (not tell) anyone.
4 If I ___ (be) you, I'd apologise.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘g‘ri mayl shakli bilan to‘ldiring. Qavsdagi fe’lni o‘zgartiring. Har birida qaysi qoida ishlayotganini ham ayting: mandativ subjunktiv, noreal o‘tgan zamon yoki were-subjunktiv. Ikkinchi va uchinchisida zamon o‘tgan, lekin ma’no hozirgi ekanini unutmang.
scenes.say: Complete each sentence with the correct form, and name the rule.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni to‘g‘ri shakl bilan to‘ldiring va qoidani nomlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 be (mandative subjunctive)
2 went (unreal past)
3 didn't tell (unreal past)
4 were (were-subjunctive)
scenes.say_native: Birinchisi: “insisted that she be present” — asos shakl, zamonga qaramay. Britancha “should be” ham to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi: “It's time the children went to bed” — o‘tgan shakl, lekin hozirgi ma’no. Uchinchisi: “I'd rather you didn't tell anyone”. To‘rtinchisi: “If I were you” — qotgan ibora, “was” bu yerda rasmiy nutqda qabul qilinmaydi.
scenes.say: The board insisted that she be present. Notice that 'insisted' is in the past, but 'be' does not change.
scenes.say_uz: Kengash uning ishtirok etishini talab qildi. E’tibor bering, “insisted” o‘tgan zamonda, lekin “be” o‘zgarmaydi.

scenes.title: Joy inversiyasi
board: On the hill stood an old castle.
Here comes the bus. BUT Here it comes.
Down came the rain. · In walked the inspector.

examples.t: At the end of the corridor was a small door.
examples.uz: Yo‘lak oxirida kichik eshik bor edi.

examples.t: There goes my weekend!
examples.uz: Mana, dam olish kunlarim ham ketdi!

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu — murakkab so‘z tartibi. Joy yoki yo‘nalish ravishi boshga chiqsa, asosiy fe’l eganing oldiga o‘tadi, yordamchi fe’lsiz: “On the hill stood an old castle”. Bu tasviriy, adabiy uslub. So‘zlashuvda “Here comes the bus”, “There goes my weekend”. Muhim qoida: ega olmosh bo‘lsa, inversiya bo‘lmaydi: “Here it comes”, “Off they went”. Bu faqat be, come, go, stand, lie kabi harakat va holat fe’llari bilan ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Into the room walked a tall man in a grey coat. Behind him came two police officers.
scenes.say_uz: Xonaga kulrang paltoli novcha odam kirib keldi. Uning ortidan ikki politsiyachi keldi.

scenes.title: So / Such inversiyasi
board: So + adjective + be + subject + that …
So severe was the storm that the airport closed.
Such was his anger that he couldn't speak.

examples.t: So popular was the show that tickets sold out in minutes.
examples.uz: Shou shunchalik mashhur ediki, chiptalar bir necha daqiqada tugadi.

examples.t: Such was the demand that the factory doubled production.
examples.uz: Talab shunchalik katta ediki, zavod ishlab chiqarishni ikki baravar oshirdi.

scenes.say_native: Natijani ta’kidlovchi yana bir rasmiy tuzilma. Oddiy gap: “The storm was so severe that the airport closed.” Ta’kidli: “So severe was the storm that…” — sifat “so” bilan boshga chiqadi va “be” egadan oldin keladi. “Such” bilan esa “such” o‘zi kesim vazifasida: “Such was his anger that…”, ya’ni “uning g‘azabi shunchalik ediki”. Bunday gaplar publitsistika va tarixiy hikoyada ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: So great was the crowd that the doors had to be closed an hour early.
scenes.say_uz: Olomon shunchalik ko‘p ediki, eshiklarni bir soat oldin yopishga to‘g‘ri keldi.

scenes.title: End weight va extraposition
board: Heavy information goes last.
✓ It is surprising that so few people voted.
✓ I find it hard to believe that he left.

examples.t: That so few people voted is surprising. (possible, heavy)
examples.uz: Shunchalik kam odam ovoz bergani hayratlanarli. (og‘ir)

examples.t: He explained to us the reasons for his sudden departure.
examples.uz: U to‘satdan ketishining sabablarini bizga tushuntirdi.

scenes.say_native: Ingliz tilida uzun, og‘ir bo‘lak gap oxiriga qo‘yiladi: end weight tamoyili. Shuning uchun uzun ega o‘rniga “it” qo‘yiladi va asl ega oxirga suriladi: “It is surprising that so few people voted.” Bu extraposition deyiladi. To‘ldiruvchi ham shunday: “I find it hard to believe that…” O‘zbekchada aksincha, kesim gap oxirida turadi va og‘ir bo‘lak undan oldin keladi. Shuning uchun o‘zbekona tartib inglizchada og‘ir eshitiladi.
scenes.say: English likes to save the heavy luggage for the end of the sentence. Light first, heavy last.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tili og‘ir yukni gap oxiriga qoldirishni yaxshi ko‘radi. Avval yengil, oxirida og‘ir.

scenes.title: So‘z tartibidagi xatolar
board: ✗ Here comes he. → ✓ Here he comes.
✗ So the storm was severe that … → ✓ So severe was the storm that …
✗ I find difficult to believe it. → ✓ I find it difficult to believe.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi — olmosh bilan joy inversiyasi: “Here comes he” emas, “Here he comes”. Ikkinchisi — “so”ni boshga chiqarib, sifatni qoldirib ketish: sifat “so” bilan birga harakatlanadi. Uchinchisi — “find”, “make”, “consider” dan keyin “it”ni tushirib qoldirish. O‘zbek tilida bunday soxta to‘ldiruvchi yo‘q, shuning uchun u tez-tez tushib qoladi: “I find it difficult”, “She made it clear that…”
scenes.say: She made it clear that she wasn't coming. Without 'it', the sentence simply collapses.
scenes.say_uz: U kelmasligini aniq aytdi. “It” bo‘lmasa, gap shunchaki qulab tushadi.

scenes.title: Tartibni o‘zgartiring
board: 1 A huge oak tree stood in the middle of the field. (In the middle…)
2 The demand was so high that prices doubled. (So high…)
3 That he resigned surprised everyone. (It…)
4 The taxi is coming! (Here…)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni qavsdagi so‘zlardan boshlab qayta tuzing. Birinchisi joy inversiyasi, ikkinchisi “so” inversiyasi, uchinchisi extraposition, to‘rtinchisi so‘zlashuvdagi “Here” inversiyasi. To‘rtinchisi uchun qo‘shimcha savol: agar “the taxi” o‘rniga “it” bo‘lsa, gap qanday bo‘ladi?
scenes.say: Rewrite each sentence from the words in brackets. For number four, try it with a pronoun too.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapni qavsdagi so‘zlardan boshlab qayta yozing. To‘rtinchisini olmosh bilan ham sinab ko‘ring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 In the middle of the field stood a huge oak tree.
2 So high was the demand that prices doubled.
3 It surprised everyone that he resigned.
4 Here comes the taxi! · Here it comes!
scenes.say_native: Birinchisida “stood” eganing oldiga o‘tadi, yordamchi fe’l kerak emas. Ikkinchisida “so high” birga boshga chiqadi va “was” egadan oldin keladi. Uchinchisida og‘ir ega oxirga suriladi, o‘rniga “it” qo‘yiladi. To‘rtinchisida ot bilan “Here comes the taxi”, olmosh bilan esa inversiyasiz “Here it comes”. Barchasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, so‘z tartibini to‘liq boshqara olasiz.
scenes.say: In the middle of the field stood a huge oak tree. Read it aloud, and you can almost see the camera moving towards it.
scenes.say_uz: Dala o‘rtasida ulkan eman daraxti turardi. Uni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing, kamera unga yaqinlashib borayotganini deyarli ko‘rasiz.

scenes.title: Uslub xaritasi
board: Formal / literary: negative inversion, subjunctive, absolute clauses
Neutral, speech & writing: clefts, extraposition
Casual: Here comes…, There goes…

examples.t: Formal: Should you require further information, …
examples.uz: Rasmiy: Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot kerak bo‘lsa, …

examples.t: Casual: If you need anything else, just shout.
examples.uz: Norasmiy: Yana biror narsa kerak bo‘lsa, ayting.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu — uslubga qarab grammatik tanlov. Inkor inversiyasi, shart inversiyasi, subjunktiv va mustaqil oborotlar rasmiy, adabiy yoki notiqlik uslubiga xos. Cleft va extraposition neytral, ham og‘zaki, ham yozma nutqda tabiiy. “Here comes”, “There goes” esa so‘zlashuvga xos. Oldingi darslardagi registr bilimingizni grammatikaga ham qo‘llang: tuzilma ham so‘z kabi uslubga ega.
scenes.say: Grammar has register, just like vocabulary. 'Should you require assistance' belongs in a hotel letter, not in a text to your brother.
scenes.say_uz: Grammatikaning ham, lug‘at kabi, registri bor. “Yordam talab qilinsa” mehmonxona xatiga tegishli, ukangizga yozgan xabarga emas.

scenes.title: Ma’lumot oqimi: eskidan yangiga
board: Given → New (ma’lum → yangi)
Fronting & passive keep the topic in front
End focus: the newest idea goes last

examples.t: The study was led by Dr Karimova. Her findings were published in 2023.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotga doktor Karimova rahbarlik qildi. Uning natijalari 2023-yilda e’lon qilindi.

examples.t: This problem we have already solved. The next one is harder.
examples.uz: Bu muammoni allaqachon hal qildik. Keyingisi qiyinroq.

scenes.say_native: Matnning ravonligi ham grammatik tanlovga bog‘liq. Ingliz tilida gap odatda ma’lum ma’lumotdan boshlanadi va yangi ma’lumot bilan tugaydi. Majhul nisbat va fronting aynan shunga xizmat qiladi: oldingi gapdagi mavzu keyingi gapning boshida turadi. Shunda o‘quvchi fikrni oson kuzatadi. Yangi va eng muhim g‘oya esa oxirga qo‘yiladi, chunki tabiiy urg‘u ham shu yerda.
scenes.say: Good writers pass the baton. Each sentence picks up where the last one ended, and then carries the idea one step further.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi yozuvchilar estafeta tayoqchasini uzatadi. Har bir gap oldingisi tugagan joydan boshlanadi va fikrni bir qadam oldinga olib boradi.

scenes.title: Bir fikr, uch uslub
board: Neutral: I didn't realise the danger until later.
Emphatic: It was only later that I realised the danger.
Literary: Only later did I realise the danger.

examples.t: Neutral: The plan failed because nobody trusted it.
examples.uz: Reja muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ldi, chunki hech kim unga ishonmadi.

examples.t: Emphatic: What doomed the plan was a lack of trust.
examples.uz: Rejani halok qilgan narsa ishonchsizlik edi.

scenes.say_native: Bir fikrni uch xil tuzish mumkin. Neytral: “I didn't realise the danger until later.” Ta’kidli cleft: “It was only later that I realised…” Adabiy inversiya: “Only later did I realise…” Ma’no bir xil, ta’sir esa har xil. C2 darajasidagi yozuvchi bularni tasodifan emas, ongli tanlaydi: oddiy gaplar fonida bitta ta’kidli tuzilma kuchli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Only later did I realise the danger. It sounds like the opening of a novel, because that's exactly where you'd find it.
scenes.say_uz: Faqat keyinroq xavfni angladim. Bu roman boshlanishiga o‘xshaydi, chunki uni aynan o‘sha yerda uchratasiz.

scenes.title: Haddan ortiq bezak
board: ✗ (text to a friend) Had I known you were coming, never would I have left!
✓ If I'd known you were coming, I'd never have left!
✗ Three inversions in one paragraph
scenes.say_native: Murakkab tuzilmani o‘rgangan o‘quvchining xatosi — uni hamma joyda ishlatish. Do‘stingizga yozgan xabarda “Had I known… never would I have…” kulgili va dabdabali eshitiladi. Bir xatboshida uchta inversiya esa parodiyaga o‘xshaydi. Qoida: murakkab tuzilma ziravorga o‘xshaydi, ozgina bo‘lsa ta’m beradi, ko‘p bo‘lsa ovqatni buzadi. Matnning asosi oddiy, aniq gaplar bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Complex structures are spices, not the main course. One, well placed, is unforgettable. Five in a row is just showing off.
scenes.say_uz: Murakkab tuzilmalar ziravor, asosiy taom emas. Joyida qo‘yilgan bittasi unutilmas. Ketma-ket beshtasi shunchaki maqtanish.

scenes.title: Tinglash: esse bo‘yicha maslahat
board: A writing tutor and a student, Kamola
Listen for: advice on grammar and style
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Kamola universitetda esse yozgan va o‘qituvchisi bilan uni muhokama qilyapti. O‘qituvchi grammatik tuzilmalar bo‘yicha uslubiy maslahatlar beradi. Uning har bir tavsiyasini va qaysi tuzilmaga tegishli ekanini aniqlashga harakat qiling. Shuningdek, o‘qituvchining o‘zi qanday grammatik shakllardan foydalanayotganiga ham quloq soling.
scenes.say: Tutor: Your argument's strong, Kamola, but every sentence starts with 'The government'. Kamola: Should I invert some of them? Tutor: Once, perhaps. 'Rarely has a policy been so misunderstood.' Three times, and it becomes a parody. Kamola: So what else can I do? Tutor: Use a cleft for your key claim: 'What the policy ignores is rural schools.' Kamola: And the conclusion? Tutor: It's essential that it be short. End on your strongest point, not your weakest.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Dalilingiz kuchli, Kamola, lekin har bir gap “Hukumat” bilan boshlanadi. Kamola: Ba’zilarini inversiya qilaymi? O‘qituvchi: Bir marta, ehtimol. “Kamdan-kam siyosat bunchalik noto‘g‘ri tushunilgan.” Uch marta bo‘lsa, parodiyaga aylanadi. Kamola: Unda yana nima qilsam bo‘ladi? O‘qituvchi: Asosiy da’vongiz uchun cleft ishlating: “Siyosat e’tiborsiz qoldirgan narsa — qishloq maktablari.” Kamola: Xulosa-chi? O‘qituvchi: Uning qisqa bo‘lishi shart. Eng zaif emas, eng kuchli fikringiz bilan tugating.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1 What is the problem with Kamola's essay?
2 What does the tutor say about inversion?
3 Which structure should she use for her key claim?
4 Find the subjunctive in the tutor's last line.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Kamolaning essesidagi muammo nimada? O‘qituvchi inversiya haqida nima deydi? Asosiy da’vo uchun qaysi tuzilmani tavsiya qiladi? Va o‘qituvchining oxirgi gapidagi subjunktiv shaklni toping. Javoblarni qisqa inglizcha jumlalar bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. Answer briefly, in English.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol. Qisqa, inglizcha javob bering.

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1 Every sentence starts the same way.
2 Once is powerful; three times is a parody.
3 A wh-cleft: What the policy ignores is …
4 It's essential that it be short.
scenes.say_native: Muammo — bir xil boshlanish: har bir gap “The government” bilan boshlangan, bu zerikarli. O‘qituvchi inversiyani bir marta ishlatishni maslahat beradi: ko‘p bo‘lsa, parodiya. Asosiy da’vo uchun wh-cleft: “What the policy ignores is rural schools”, bunda yangi ma’lumot oxirida turadi. Subjunktiv: “It's essential that it be short”, “is” emas, “be”. Kamola savolidagi “Should I” esa oddiy modal savol, inversiya emas.
scenes.say: The tutor's advice is the whole lesson in miniature: vary your structures, choose each one for a reason, and never overdo it.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchining maslahati butun darsning kichik nusxasi: tuzilmalarni xilma-xil qiling, har birini sababli tanlang va hech qachon oshirib yubormang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ta’kid va pauza
board: It-cleft: It was AZIZ who found it. (was = /wəz/)
Wh-cleft: What we need | is TIME.
Inversion: NEVER have I seen … (stress the negative)

examples.t: What I really want | is a holiday.
examples.uz: Menga haqiqatan kerak bo‘lgani — ta’til.

scenes.say_native: Bu tuzilmalar og‘zaki nutqda ohang bilan birga ishlaydi. It-cleftda asosiy urg‘u ta’kidlangan bo‘lakka tushadi: “It was AZIZ who…”, “was” esa kuchsiz /wəz/. Wh-cleftda “is” dan oldin qisqa pauza qilinadi va urg‘u oxirgi so‘zga tushadi: “What we need | is TIME.” Inkor inversiyasida esa boshdagi inkor so‘z urg‘uli: “NEVER have I seen”. Ohangsiz aytilsa, bu tuzilmalarning kuchi yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: It was Aziz who found the error, not me. What we need is time. Never have I seen such a mess.
scenes.say_uz: Xatoni men emas, aynan Aziz topdi. Bizga kerak bo‘lgani — vaqt. Hech qachon bunday tartibsizlikni ko‘rmaganman.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq
board: Topic: a decision that changed your life
Use: inversion · cleft · subjunctive
+ concessive fronting · extraposition
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Hayotingizni o‘zgartirgan bir qaror haqida beshta gap ayting yoki yozing. Har bir gapda bugungi tuzilmalardan biri bo‘lsin: inkor yoki shart inversiyasi, cleft, subjunktiv, “Strange as it may seem” turidagi fronting va extraposition. Gaplar bir-biriga bog‘lanib, kichik hikoya hosil qilsin. Ohang va pauzaga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Five sentences, five structures, one story. Take your time, and make every structure earn its place.
scenes.say_uz: Beshta gap, beshta tuzilma, bitta hikoya. Shoshilmang va har bir tuzilma o‘z o‘rnini oqlasin.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: Had I stayed … · Strange as it may seem …
What changed everything was …
insisted that I be … · It still amazes me that …
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang. Unda shart inversiyasi “Had I stayed”, to‘siqsiz fronting “Strange as it may seem”, wh-cleft “What changed everything was”, subjunktiv “insisted that I be” va extraposition “It still amazes me that” bor. Hikoya tabiiy oqadi, chunki tuzilmalar orasida oddiy gaplar ham bor va har bir tuzilma ma’lum maqsadga xizmat qiladi.
scenes.say: Had I stayed in my old job, I would never have met my best friends. Strange as it may seem, it was a rejection that saved me. What changed everything was a single email. My new manager insisted that I be given a chance. It still amazes me that one decision could matter so much.
scenes.say_uz: Eski ishimda qolganimda, eng yaqin do‘stlarim bilan hech qachon tanishmagan bo‘lardim. G‘alati tuyulsa ham, meni rad javobi qutqardi. Hammasini o‘zgartirgan narsa bitta xat edi. Yangi rahbarim menga imkoniyat berilishini talab qildi. Bitta qaror bunchalik muhim bo‘lishi meni hali ham hayratga soladi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: tuzilmalar
board: Never have I… · No sooner… than · Had I known…
It was X that… · What I need is… · Strange as it may seem…
insist that he be · It's time we left · On the hill stood…
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Inkor inversiyasi: boshga chiqqan inkor ravishdan keyin savoldagi tartib. Shart inversiyasi: faqat had, should, were. Cleft gaplar ta’kid uchun. To‘siqsiz fronting: “but”siz. Mandativ subjunktiv: asos shakl, “do”siz inkor. Noreal o‘tgan zamon: “It's time we left”. Joy inversiyasi: olmosh bilan yo‘q. End weight: og‘ir bo‘lak oxirda.
scenes.say: Invert after negatives, cleft for focus, use the base form after demands, and save the heavy part for the end.
scenes.say_uz: Inkordan keyin inversiya qiling, ta’kid uchun cleft ishlating, talabdan keyin asos shakl qo‘llang va og‘ir qismni oxirga qoldiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Write 10 sentences with complex structures
At least 6 different structures · mark each one
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: murakkab tuzilmali o‘nta gap yozing. Kamida oltita turli tuzilma bo‘lsin: inkor inversiyasi, shart inversiyasi, cleft, to‘siqsiz fronting, subjunktiv, joy yoki “so” inversiyasi, extraposition. Har bir gap yoniga tuzilma nomini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta gapning kamida to‘qqiztasi grammatik jihatdan xatosiz va har biri mos uslubda. Keyingi darsda adabiy matnlarni tahlil qilishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Ten sentences, at least six different structures. Label each one, and read them aloud with the right stress.
scenes.say_uz: O‘nta gap, kamida oltita turli tuzilma. Har birini belgilang va to‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.

homework_uz: Murakkab tuzilmali 10 ta gap yozing, kamida 6 xil tuzilmadan foydalaning (inkor inversiyasi, shart inversiyasi, cleft, to‘siqsiz fronting, mandativ subjunktiv, joy yoki “so” inversiyasi, extraposition) va har bir gap yoniga tuzilma nomini yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida 9 ta gap grammatik jihatdan xatosiz va har biri mos uslubda ishlatilgan.

options: Never I have seen such a mess.
Never have I seen such a mess.
Never I saw such a mess.
Never seen I have such a mess.
quiz.why_uz: Inkor ravish boshga chiqsa, yordamchi fe’l egadan oldin keladi: Never have I seen.

quiz.q: No sooner had we arrived ___ it started to snow.
___ you require further information, please contact us.
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy shart inversiyasi: Should you require = If you require.

quiz.q: Which is the correct negative of 'If I had known'?
quiz.why_uz: Shart inversiyasida inkor: Had I not known. “Hadn't I known” xato.

quiz.q: The doctor recommended that he ___ for a week.
quiz.why_uz: Mandativ subjunktiv: that + asos shakl, -s yo‘q.
Suggest + that + subjunktiv (yoki should). “Suggest him to go” — ruscha ta’sirdagi xato.
It's (high) time + o‘tgan shakl, hozirgi ma’noda.

options: Much as I like him, but I can't agree.
Much as I like him, I can't agree.
As much I like him, I can't agree.
Much I like him, I can't agree.
quiz.why_uz: To‘siqsiz fronting “but”siz ishlatiladi: Much as I like him, I can't agree.
Ega olmosh bo‘lsa, joy inversiyasi bo‘lmaydi: Here he comes.

quiz.q: Which sentence has a dangling participle?
options: Having finished lunch, we went back to work.
Walking home, I saw an old friend.
quiz.why_uz: “Walking home” egasi “the rain” bo‘lib qoladi — yomg‘ir uyga yurmaydi. Bu egasiz oborot.
